label: Alcabitius in the Vernacular
variants: Alcabitius in the vernacular, by Serigatto

value.text: no. 116, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 116 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Alcabitius in the vernacular, by Serigatto".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Libellus isagogicus. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 10th century · Printed 1473.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition

background.text: An Italian version of the introduction to astrology of al Qabisi (Alcabitius).
